text: Now let's talk about some science that's literally out of this world. <cite index='14-13'>Scientists at UC Santa Barbara have created a remarkable new material that works like a 'rechargeable solar battery,' storing sunlight inside tiny molecules and releasing it later as heat</cite>. text: That's incredible! speaker: charlie
text: Quantum teleportation, eh? We might not be beaming up to the Enterprise just yet, but we're definitely getting closer.
